leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a Vue component with reactive data properties for dashboard metrics
Initialize and configure real-time data updates using lifecycle hooks
Implement computed properties to transform and format raw dashboard data
Bind dynamic CSS classes to visualize metric thresholds and status changes
Control the rendering of dashboard sections with conditional directives
Integrate event handlers to manage user interactions with dashboard controls
Manipulate component state in response to simulated real-time data streams
Apply Vue's reactivity system to automatically update the dashboard UI
